name: What should I prepare before requesting a shower replacement quote?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a shower replacement quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling your estimate, document what you dislike about your current shower, such as lack of storage, poor water pressure, or difficult step-over heights. Measure your general bathroom layout and establish a realistic budget range. It is helpful to decide early whether you want custom tile, built-in recessed niches, bench seating, or frameless glass doors. You should also verify contractor credentials; Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms maintains active insurance, bonding, and workers' compensation coverage, ensuring that your home and property are fully protected throughout the tear-out and rebuilding phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your functional goals, measure your rough space, note desired features like niches or benches, and ensure your contractor carries verified insurance, bonding, and workers' compensation.
